race.comment: SNITZSTREAM (6) broke through for an overdue maiden win at Ipswich, and as so often happens once the penny drops, she won again at the Sunshine Coast by a short here just over a fortnight ago. She is now starting to race up to her breeding, and should be hard to hold out again. IDYLLIC AFFAIR (8) is resuming from a spell of over a year, and has had a quiet trial last month. She was very talented earlier in her career, and the market will be the best guide. READY FOR AIMEE (5) has been a beaten favourite twice since winning at Ipswich in August, and a drop in weight will help her. Follow your money. LEBANESE (4) capped off some good form with a tough all the way win by a nose at Ipswich nearly 4 weeks ago. A wide gate is no help, but still keep her safe in all top 4 combos. RUN LUCY RUN (2) should just about be ready fifth up from a spell, and this is the right sort of race for her down in class. Each way value.
